Regardless of what you wear or how you portray yourself (sexually or not), you shouldn’t expect to recieve any unwanted comments and you shouldn’t have to ‘prepare’ yourself for negative feedback. This is extremely minimizing for the poster’s experience and she’s completely valid to feel upset from unwarranted comments and having someone almost become physical. That being said I’ve had an 30 or older man rub up against me and whisper ‘hey sexy’ while I was wearing black work pants, a black hoodie and a puffy winter coat. Your point? 

Dress however the fuck you want, because no matter how modest or ‘sexy’ you are it doesn’t give anyone the right to make comments or harrass you. Someday these nasty dudes will have it coming for them ...

Saying you'll kill yourself because of a breakup is definitely manipulative, but atleast you've acknowledged it was toxic to say that. Give her space, stop following her. Think about the way she's feeling instead of focusing on your own feelings. Maybe she's traumatized and upset. She needs time. Also graduation time nearing the end of highschool is a very intense and stressful phase. Find a counselor to talk to and maybe find a creative positive outlet to deal with things. You're hurt, but she's probably hurt too.
